text: int8 wall re-measured, interleaved, on two clips: 1.65x end to end (null and nvenc sinks), 1.14x and 0.93x on a lossless sink where the writer is the bottleneck. The 2026-11-18 medians W009/W025/W041/W057 are superseded: that body ran 44.6-47.9 ms/frame, today's runs 26.5, so the recorded 1.09-1.14x described a build that no longer exists. Picture, A/A identical in both arms: lossless worst frame 0.00048% (w1040) and 0.08491% (w960), 0 frames over the bar on either clip; through the delivery encode 0.3471% with 90/205 frames over (w1040) and 0.09176% with 0/201 (w960) - the encoder, not the body, moves those pixels.

The 4x path measured, which the unit tests could only algebraically: gate reuses 27/41 at threshold 5 on the 4x animevideov3; with the correction the worst frame is 0.05626% and the MEDIAN is 0.00000% (verbatim 0.05389% and 0.00407%), both under the bar. Cost at 4320p is the finding: 40.0 ms/frame corrected against 24.9 verbatim and 55.9 ungated, i.e. 1.40x instead of 2.25x, because a corrected frame is new and has to be converted for the writer while verbatim re-emitted the cached bytes.
